scope: Vendored runtime source inventory and high/critical advisory triage; not a deployed-binary SBOM or vulnerability-free certification.

assessment_definitions.patch: Relevant high/critical vulnerable code and supported caller found; patch or reviewed upstream revision needed.
assessment_definitions.upgrade: Upgrade recommended; see report for exposure preconditions.
assessment_definitions.conditional: Known advisories screened; conditions or local mitigations matter.
assessment_definitions.maintenance: Known security maintenance item with no confirmed high-CVE exposure in current callers.
assessment_definitions.screened: No actionable matching high/critical CVE established in this pass; not a guarantee of safety.
assessment_definitions.snapshot: Release provenance incomplete; repository revision and fingerprint identify source, but version-range exclusions may be incomplete.
assessment_definitions.fixed: Specific screened high CVE condition already fixed locally.
assessment_definitions.owned: eepp-maintained fork with no upstream release to track; reviewed as eepp code.

components.name: gumbo-parser
components.notes: Updated 2026-10-26 from codeberg 6dddad6 (0.13.2+9, no local source edits) to 0.14.1, which fixes two use-after-frees and a crash in selectedcontent handling and an uninitialized quirks-mode read; eepp's copy contained that code and parses untrusted web HTML. Library sources match the release; visualc/include/strings.h is upstream's MSVC shim. Nokogiri fork hashmap CVE is different code.

components.name: jpeg-compressor

components.name: libogg
components.notes: Both C sources and both public non-generated headers exactly match v1.3.3; config_types.h is generated configuration.

components.name: libpng
components.notes: Library and architecture sources match v1.6.59; pnglibconf.h matches release prebuilt config. Includes ARM Neon palette-expansion and later fixes. RGB/RGBA partial-Neon-chunk regression passed on ARM64.

components.name: libssh2
components.notes: Unreleased upstream snapshot; original high/critical findings and subsequent upstream fixes incorporated. Preserves static platform config, classic Mbed TLS digest/HMAC/CTR-DRBG API and adapted Monocypher Ed25519/X25519 integration. See README.eepp.

components.name: libvorbis
components.notes: All imported include/ and lib/ files match the 1.3.7 release; standalone tool sources stay excluded. Encoder low-sample-rate and invalid-setup regression test added.

components.name: libwebp
components.notes: No matching high library CVE found. Old CVE-2023-4863 already fixed by this version; Perl/Node wrapper matches excluded.

components.name: libyaml
components.notes: ecode linter uses parser API with initialization; no high actionable library CVE found. Several 2024 reports were API misuse or withdrawn.

components.name: libzip
components.notes: Replaced the 0.10 fork with upstream lib/ sources; hand-written config.h/zipconf.h, generated zip_err_str.c. Old offset/size and allocation arithmetic is gone. Only zip.h's zipconf.h include is patched. The fork's ZIP_LIMIT_METADATA bounded open and the VFS ZIP limits were removed at the maintainer's direction. bzip2/xz/zstd/WinZip AES not built.

components.name: mbedtls
components.notes: Library sources and headers match the 3.6.7 LTS release except include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h, whose eepp block is retained (PSA crypto, TLS 1.3, LMS and weak key exchanges disabled). Restored PSA sources compile to empty objects. TLS client trust/hostname test added.

components.name: md4c
components.notes: Updated 2026-10-26 from upstream 481fbfb (0.5.2+16) plus one local md4c-html.c change to 0.6.0 unmodified. The local change wrote XHTML task-list checkboxes; upstream now emits identical output under MD_HTML_FLAG_XHTML, which eepp passes. Older CVEs predate these APIs.

components.name: mojoAL
components.notes: SDL2 audio backend; OpenAL API version 1.1 is not the library release.

components.name: mojoAL-SDL3
components.notes: SDL3 variant; release macros in source. Local patch: MOJOAL_TARGETING_NEON replaces SDL_TARGETING("neon"), which GCC rejects on AArch64 where NEON is always available.

components.name: monocypher
components.notes: monocypher.{c,h} and monocypher-ed25519.{c,h} match the 4.0.3 release, fixing the compiler-dependent Ed25519 signing timing leak used by the SSH backend.

components.name: nanosvg
components.notes: Same modified FLTK-derived snapshot; exact base still unknown. 2026-10-25: arc finite checks, guarded fixed-point casts and scanline advancement, bounded stroke tessellation. 2026-10-26 (found by fuzzing): single-stop gradient heap over-read, unbounded dashing capped at 16384 segments per rasterization, NaN-safe clamp and round-join segment count. Eight regression tests pass.

components.name: nlohmann
components.notes: Matching public forward header under include/eepp/thirdparty. Envoy exception-handling CVE is not a JSON library version defect.

components.name: oniguruma
components.notes: No matching high CVE found; original upstream repository is archived, so future maintenance needs an explicit policy.

components.name: pcre2
components.notes: Updated 2026-10-26 from 10.44 to 10.49 (pcre2-10.49.tar.bz2, SHA-256 53c156e1ba416a20da8e65395daa132da0d80e76910424caca3fcdae7831d384). Library sources, pcre2.h (from pcre2.h.generic), pcre2_chartables.c (from .dist) and deps/sljit match the release; only eepp's per-platform src/config.h is local. eepp uses 8-bit pcre2_match with fresh match data and no growable JIT stack, DFA or pattern-convert callers.

components.name: SOIL2
components.notes: Submodule 116dfde76de4ebac11531c98dfb45e4fae400948; CMake project version 1.0.0 is stale. Includes stb_image 2.30 and stb_image_write 1.16 plus custom container codecs. 257964f enables stb_image's existing NEON JPEG kernels on AArch64; no decoder logic changed. 116dfde fixes CVE-2026-5185 (stale animated-GIF disposal pointer after realloc in stbi__load_gif_main).
